meta.name: browser-cdp
meta.description: Use this skill when you need to control a Chrome browser via CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol) to reuse existing login sessions. Covers: launching Chrome in debug mode, opening URLs, waiting for page load, evaluating JavaScript, taking snapshots, and extracting auth tokens. Trigger phrases: browser automation, CDP, agent-browser, 浏览器操作, 操作浏览器, Chrome CDP, 复用登录态, extract token from browser.

copy.tagline: 用CDP协议控制Chrome浏览器，自动化执行页面操作与令牌提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要脚本化操作Chrome浏览器并复用已有登录态
copy.tagline_en: Control Chrome via CDP to automate browsing and extract auth tokens
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to script Chrome interactions while reusing existing login sessions

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能复用你已有的浏览器登录状态,自动打开网页、读取页面文字、点击输入,还能取出登录令牌,全程无需重新登录。
howto.when: 当你说出「browser automation」「CDP」「浏览器操作」等关键词,或要求控制 Chrome 复用登录态、提取 auth token 时触发。

say.text: 帮我打开某个网页,把页面文字读出来。
say.note: 若你的 Chrome 正在运行,会先征求同意再启动。

say.text: 用我已登录的浏览器,去某网站抓数据。
say.note: 复用登录态,避免重新登录。

say.text: 从浏览器里提取登录 token。
say.note: 通过 localStorage 或 cookie 获取。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can reuse your existing browser login: it launches Chrome in debug mode, opens URLs, waits for pages to load, extracts text, clicks/types, takes snapshots, and pulls auth tokens—no re-login needed.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to automate a browser, control Chrome, reuse a login session, or extract an auth token—keywords include 'browser automation', 'CDP', '浏览器操作', etc.

say_en.text: Open this page in Chrome and read out the text.
say_en.note: Asks for consent before restarting Chrome.

say_en.text: Use my logged-in browser to collect data from this site.
Extract the auth token from the browser.
